name: testimpact-monorepo
description: TestImpact by Workfonic Labs. Change code. Know what to test.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @testimpact/playground
scripts.playground: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @testimpact/playground
scripts.pack:check: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @testimpact/framework-adapters --workspace @testimpact/dependency-analyzer --workspace @testimpact/test-discovery --workspace @testimpact/core --workspace testimpact
